title: Four Ways, One Hole
scene: Clear cold dusk on a Kent four-way that still has all four stops. You arrive second. A primer sedan is already stopped on your right, a beat longer than you. Nobody else. The insulin is a minute from the shelter drop. The sedan's driver is not moving. They may be looking at a paper. They may be waiting for you to steal it. First in is first through. Your right is not a permission slip if they were there first. The Menace's idle is a drum if you rev it. You do not.
decision: You rolled up second. The sedan on your right is first and still sitting. Who takes the hole?

options.text: Take it — they froze, and the drop will not wait
options.result: You go. They go. The two of you occupy the same paint. A freeze, a horn, a miss by a plow's width. First-in was not a suggestion. You made it a coin flip.

options.text: Wave them through even if you think you were first
options.result: You wave. They wave. Nobody goes. Then you both go. Courtesy without a rule is two people guessing. The intersection stays a mess for a third car that did not exist until it did.

options.text: Inch into the box to claim it so they have to wait
options.result: Your plow is in the conflict. They have to go around it or sit. They sit, then panic-go. You taught the four-way that steel is right-of-way. It is not.

options.text: Stay stopped. They were first. When they take it, you take the next hole
options.result: You wait. They were looking at a paper. They look up, take the hole, and leave you a clean four-way. You take it. No horn. The drop is one minute later and still a drop.

debrief: At an all-way stop, the first vehicle to arrive goes first. If two arrive together, yield to the right. Wait out a frozen driver until they move. Waving is how two people enter the box at once.

source.psdp_skill: Skill five: driving on a quiet street – part two
source.teaching_target: All-way stop: first to arrive goes first; if simultaneous, yield to the right; do not occupy the box to force the issue.

image_brief.subject: a four-way with four stop signs, the Pink Menace at the south stop, a primer sedan already sitting at the east stop
image_brief.midground: two vehicles, no third, dusk long shadows
image_brief.background: Kent residential arterial, clear cold sky going blue, no wrecks
image_brief.read: the sedan's stop line was occupied first — the Beetle is second
